title: Empathy for Pain: AI/ACC Affective Representation (Singer et al. 2004)

source.title: Empathy for pain involves the affective but not sensory components of pain
source.version_note: Science 303(5661):1157-1162. Anterior insula/rostral ACC affective representation.

passage: Empathy for pain activates anterior insula and rostral anterior cingulate cortex (affective components) but not sensory components. Shared affective representation enables empathy.
context: Neuroscience domain: shared affective representation and empathy. Relevant to AI repository's shared representation of external query affect vs internal state.
source_note: Verified via DOI; anterior insula/rostral ACC and affective representation confirmed.
